name: Quinoa Bowl with Kale Chips, Marinated Chickpeas & Tahini Dressing

instructions.primary_message: In a medium saucepan, combine quinoa and broth; bring to a boil. Reduce heat to a simmer, cover, and cook for 15 minutes. Remove from heat and let stand, covered, for 5 minutes.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ cups quinoa
710 ml chicken or vegetable broth

instructions.primary_message: Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ bunches kale
3 lemons
1 ½ English cucumbers
1 ½ bunches radish

instructions.primary_message: Fold kale leaves in half lengthwise and slice off the stems; chop or tear leaves into large bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl.

Add nutritional yeast, oil, vinegar, and salt to the bowl with the kale; using your hands, toss the leaves well to coat. Divide between two baking sheet pans and spread out in a single layer. (Reserve bowl for later use.)
instructions.secondary_message:
¾ cup nutritional yeast flakes
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
2 tbsp apple cider vinegar
½ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and bake, tossing once, until the kale is crispy, about 15 minutes. Remove from oven.
Meanwhile, drain and rinse chickpeas; set aside to drain further.
Zest and juice half of the lemons into the reserved bowl. (Reserve remaining lemons for the dressing.)
Peel and mince garlic. Add to the bowl with the lemon juice along with oil, maple syrup, Dijon, and spices; stir to combine the marinade. Add chickpeas, stir to combine, and set aside to marinate.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 cloves garlic
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper
3 pinch crushed red pepper

instructions.primary_message: Peel and mince additional garlic; place in a small bowl.
Juice the reserved lemons into the bowl with the garlic. Add tahini, water, maple syrup, Dijon, salt, and pepper; whisk to combine the dressing and set aside.
instructions.secondary_message:
½ cup tahini
⅓ cup water
1 tbsp pure maple syrup
1 ½ tsp Dijon mustard
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Trim and quarter cucumbers lengthwise, then cut crosswise into ¼-inch thick pieces.
To serve, divide quinoa, kale chips, chickpeas, cucumber, and radish between bowls. Drizzle with lemon-tahini dressing and enjoy!
